newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar paper blames Netanyahu for Israeli deaths.
newsitem.headline: Qatar paper blames Netanyahu for Israeli deaths.

text.p: A Qatari newspaper on Friday blamed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's "hardline" policies for the shooting of seven Israeli schoolgirls by a Jordanian soldier.

"This was the natural result of and direct reaction to Israel's hardline policies and attempts to turn Jerusalem into a Jewish city and delay the achievement of a just and comprehensive peace," said the daily Al-Watan in a commentary.
The newspaper, which often reflects the views of Qatar's Foreign Ministry, was referring to the incident in which the schoolgirls died during an outing near the Israeli-Jordanian border.

"This operation was not an isolated incident and not an individual act...but a product of anger at a peace process which has led to nothing but the usurpation of land, homes, honour and rights," the newspaper said.
Qatar, along with Oman, has raced ahead of other Gulf Arab states in establishing open economic ties with Israel but stopped short of diplomatic ties pending resolution of the Arab-Israeli conflict.
Doha has said it would not proceed with a planned opening of a trade mission in Israel until there was progress in the peace talks with the Palestinians.
